text: ESM-2 protein language models are trained using which objective, and on what kind of data?
choices: Reinforcement learning from human feedback on solved protein structures
Contrastive learning between paired ligand and protein structures
Supervised regression directly on experimentally measured folding free energies
A masked language model objective predicting masked residues, trained on hundreds of millions of sequences from databases like UniRef and UniProt
explanation: ESM-2 is trained with a masked language model objective, predicting masked residues across large protein sequence databases such as UniRef/UniProt, producing per-residue embeddings that capture structural context, evolutionary conservation, and function. It is not trained via reinforcement learning from human feedback, contrastive ligand-protein learning, or direct supervised regression on folding free energies -- those describe different technique families entirely.
